OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
       WRITING SUB-TEST: MEDICINE

       TIME ALLOWED:
       READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
       WRITING TIME: 40 MINUTES
Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.
Notes:

Mr. John Perrie, a 48 years old patient in your general practice
Patient History: Allergic to penicillin
High pain tolerance
Taking iron supplements, multivitamins and caffeine pills
Surgery for torn ACL in 2007
Broken clavicle in 2012
Car accident resulting in neck and lower back pain in 2015
Social History: Married, no children
Works as janitor
Plays tennis every two weeks
11/12/17
Subjective
Tingling sensation in left arm and hand
Occasional pain on left shoulder blade that irradiates to arm and neck
It has been presenting for the last 2 weeks
Pain can be relieved with painkillers
Review in 1/18
Objective
 
Poor posture with slouching
Muscle presents inflammation
Assessment
Muscle strain
Plan
Pt was advised to rest and stop repetitive physical activity
Suggest muscle-training therapy for long-term improvement Ibuprofen
400mg p.r.n
06/01/18
Subjective
Pain has stopped
Pt will go back to usual activities
Training therapy was not needed
Objective
No inflammation
Muscle feels supple
Assessment
Successful recovery
02/02/18
Subjective
Severe scapular pain that irradiates down to left arm present at all times
Numbness in left hand
Pt has suffered from migraines in the last week
Pain is not relieved by over-the-counter painkillers
Objective
Area presents inflammation
X-rays show no fracture
Assessment
 
Suspected compressed never in left scapula

Writing task:
Using the information in the case notes, write a letter of referral to
orthopedist Dr. Merinda Campell at the Trauma Department of University
College Hospital, 16-18 Westmoreland St, Marylebone, London W1G 8PH,
UK.
In your answer:

        Expand the relevant case notes into complete sentences
        Do not use note form
        The body of the letter should not be more than 200 words
        Use correct letter format
